summary.text: Seth Lewis is a Republican member of the Illinois State Senate representing District 24 who took office in January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He previously served in the Illinois House of Representatives from 2021 to 2023 and is a business executive.

paragraphs.text: He earned a B.S. in industrial engineering from the University of Iowa in 1991.
His career experience includes working with Culligan International and serving as vice president of operations of a business.
Lewis represented Illinois House District 45 from 2021 to 2023, succeeding Diane Pappas.
In the State Senate he succeeded Suzanne Glowiak Hilton in District 24.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 17, 2026.
